pages.text: First craft a $(bold)trellis$() ($(item)flavor_immersed_daily:trellis$()) and build it $(bold)3 blocks tall$() on dirt.$(br2)Then place more trellises $(bold)horizontally on the sides of the top layer$() - they can extend $(bold)infinitely$().

Once the structure is built, hold a $(bold)trellis crop seed$() and $(bold)right-click the bottom layer$() of the trellis.$(br2)The seed will slowly grow and spread $(bold)horizontally across the trellises at the top layer$().$(br2)$(bold)Fruits grow on those horizontal top trellises$() - $(bold)right-click to harvest$()!
